fields.name: remaining_targets
fields.description: An ordered list of [y, x] container locations for requested pickups not yet completed. At the first decision, when the demonstration is shown and incoming memory is absent, associate each requested cube with the container placed over it. Follow each such container's identity along its entire moving trajectory through the demonstration, including exchanges with unrequested or extra containers, and list its final [y, x] location in goal order. Assign endpoints using continuous motion and direction through intermediate frames, not original cube positions, nearest-position matching, or detection order. A pair departing two resting positions and settling at the opposite endpoints completes one exchange, even though the unordered set of resting positions is unchanged. The intermediate crossing is not another exchange. Only a second complete exchange of the same pair restores that pair's original assignment; an exchange with a different container does not cancel the first. Independently track every requested identity through all movements; do not include unrequested containers in the output list. An existing empty list represents completed pickups and must not be reinitialized. At the decision immediately following a successful requested pickup, remove the first entry. Do not remove an entry merely because a pickup is selected at the current decision. Putting a container down leaves the list unchanged. Thus, at steps 2 and 3 of each two-target episode, the list contains only the second target. Locations identify containers rather than requiring exact pixel agreement. e.g. [[121, 102]]
